name: Haxball
tagline: Two teams. One ball. Make the pass.
description: Move your numbered disc with a phone D-pad and hold Kick to strike on contact. Two balanced teams play two short halves on one public pitch. Odd groups get a named helper on the smaller team. Most team goals wins.
howToPlay: Find your team and numbered disc. Hold the D-pad to move; use your other thumb for Kick.
Hold Kick for one strike on contact. Release to rearm. Holding Kick slows you down.
Score in the opposite goal. Swap ends at halftime. Most goals after two halves wins.

settings.label: Seconds per half
settings.description: Two halves; goal resets count inside the clock
